title: Zoning map change for Park Avenue rezoning, Bedford-Stuyvesant
summary: This resolution approves a City Planning Commission decision changing the zoning map along Park Avenue between Bedford Avenue and Warsoff Place and Sandford Streets in Bedford-Stuyvesant, Brooklyn. It would allow ten new buildings of five to 11 stories with 391 residential units, including 101 permanently income-restricted units, along with commercial space and private school space for over 2,500 students. It is linked to a separate zoning text amendment establishing a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area.
